title: Agile Project Management Tool
description: Full-stack Agile platform used by 5–6 teams. Features sprint planning, backlog management, JWT-based RBAC, and paginated REST APIs — built with Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and React.

title: AutoAssess – AI Vehicle Damage Assessment
description: AI-powered vehicle damage assessment platform using YOLOv11 for detection and ResNet50 for classification on the CarDD dataset (~4,000 images). Spring Boot backend processes inference results and generates automated repair cost estimates; React dashboard visualizes damages with bounding boxes.

title: DriveSwift — Car Rental System
description: Car rental system with booking, fleet management, and user authentication built as a full-stack web application.
